<div class="msg"><small>Message</small><span>License runtime blocked: Hardware fingerprint disagrees with this license (N/6 match). This license was activated on a different machine…</span></div>

## Why it happens

The licence is bound to six hardware signals of the machine it was activated on. They no longer match, usually because:

- the installation was copied or moved to other hardware,
- a virtual machine was cloned or moved, or
- a Docker host's machine identity changed when the container was rebuilt.

The same message also comes from the licence server when your supplier has revoked the key.

## Fix it

- Moved on purpose: deactivate the key on the old machine, or ask your supplier to release it, then activate it on this one. See [Move to a new server](/docs/operations/move-server/).
- Docker on Linux: mount `/etc/machine-id` into the container so the fingerprint survives rebuilds. See [Install with Docker](/docs/installation/docker/#linux-hosts-keep-the-licence-bound).
- Windows: install with [Platform Manager](/docs/installation/windows/), which pins the identity.
- Key revoked: contact your supplier.

## Check that it worked

The **License** page shows the licence as active.
